Splitting into 7 separate vaults calls for a separate funded marble account and a separate escrow deposit for each, thus the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the glacier binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. A 119 account operation therefore ties up 14 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
